note.zh-TW: 教材五層利益的第 3 層，直譯自日本會計基準的経常利益；教材部分頁面把它和稅前淨利併成一列（T03）。
note.en: Level 3 of the five profit levels, a direct translation of the Japanese GAAP ordinary profit; some course pages merge it with profit before tax (T03).

definition.zh-TW: 營業利益加上業外收支後的小計。它想呈現公司在平常、會反覆發生的活動裡賺了多少；沒有非常損益時，它和稅前淨利相同。
definition.en: The subtotal after adding non-operating income and expenses to operating profit. It is meant to show what the company earns from its regular, recurring activities; when there are no extraordinary items it equals profit before tax.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 與台灣現行報表都沒有這一層。IAS 1.87 禁止把任何收益或費損列為非常項目，所以不需要再區分經常與非經常的損益；IFRS 對照的版面不顯示這一列。
ifrsNote.en: Neither IFRS nor current Taiwanese statements have this subtotal. IAS 1.87 prohibits presenting any income or expense as extraordinary, so there is no need to separate ordinary from non-ordinary results; the IFRS comparison layout hides this line.
